review.imagery: Root reviewed all twenty-eight original PDF pages, five whole drawing and context choices, the complete enlarged area schedule, both factsheets, twenty-six native brochure resources and three own website contacts. Thirteen native concepts and five own-page interior concepts are retained. Textures, generic family and amenity stock are excluded. The own marker explicitly names Reportage Village Abu Dhabi. WIN02840-1 is identical on The District and this own page, without reliable project identity. The photograph is excluded from both. The malformed current PDF link was rejected as HTML. The correct original documents retain valid PDF receipts. All five townhouse levels remain whole, with the published 3 BR and factsheet 4 BR conflict preserved.
review.floorPlans: All selected whole original sheets, complete numerical schedules, source notices and every drawn level visually reviewed by root. Measurement and source-edition conflicts remain explicit.
review.location: Whole original map and factsheets reviewed. Travel modes retain source scope. Unreliable phase markers are excluded. Missing coordinates use project-name directions.
